evals.prompt: What coffee shops are within a 10 minute walk of the Ferry Building in San Francisco?
evals.expected_output: Should run the isochrone, bbox, category search, point-in-polygon filter flow and show the area plus the kept places on one map.
expectations: Calls isochrone_tool with profile mapbox/walking, contours_minutes [10] and polygons true
Calls bbox_tool on the isochrone polygon and passes that box to category_search_tool with category cafe
Calls points_within_polygon_tool to drop results outside the walk area
Calls render_map_tool with the isochrone ref and markers for only the kept places (not the search ref)
States how many places are within reach and names the mode and time

evals.prompt: Which hospitals can I reach within 20 minutes by car from 47.6062, -122.3321?
evals.expected_output: Should use a driving isochrone rather than a straight-line radius, then search and filter hospitals inside it.
expectations: Calls isochrone_tool with a driving profile and contours_minutes [20]
Does not use a straight-line distance radius in place of the isochrone
Searches with category hospital inside the isochrone's bounding box
Filters the results with points_within_polygon_tool before answering

evals.prompt: Find pharmacies within a 5 minute walk of my hotel at 350 5th Ave, New York.
evals.expected_output: Should geocode the address first, then run the reachability flow. If no pharmacy is inside, should say so plainly and offer a longer time or another mode.
expectations: Calls search_and_geocode_tool to get the hotel's coordinates first
Calls isochrone_tool with mapbox/walking and contours_minutes [5]
If nothing is inside the area, says so plainly and suggests a longer time or another mode
Does not list places from training data
